thought.text: Server is running! Let me check docker:

reasoning_content: Actually, it seems like there was an old server running that didn't get killed properly. The new one tried to start but port was in use. But now I see HTTP 200 which means the server IS running. Let me get the docker build status while we have server running.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check docker images now  
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker images | grep -i arelorian")
print("Docker:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check running containers
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker ps")
print("Running:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
